description: Create comprehensive validation tests for the complete RLQAS system using LiH molecule. This task validates that all Phase 1 components work together correctly and achieve chemical accuracy (<1.6 mHa error) within reasonable time.

RLQAS_Phase1_001.description: Molecule processing module provides MoleculeData for LiH molecule
RLQAS_Phase1_001.usage: Process LiH molecule to obtain Hamiltonian, qubit count, reference state, and FCI energy

RLQAS_Phase1_002.description: Quantum simulator module provides energy evaluation for UCC circuits
RLQAS_Phase1_002.usage: Create simulator for 4-qubit LiH system to evaluate circuit energies

RLQAS_Phase1_003.description: PPO RL Agent provides reinforcement learning agent for UCC search
RLQAS_Phase1_003.usage: Create RL agent for the UCC search environment

RLQAS_Phase1_004.description: UCC Search Module provides search environment and controller
RLQAS_Phase1_004.usage: Create UCC search environment and controller for LiH molecule

objectives.description: Create end-to-end validation script for LiH UCC search as specified in RLQAS Phase 1 Task 005
acceptance_criteria: Implement run_lih_validation() function as described in RLQAS_Phase1_Tasks.md
Script processes LiH molecule with bond length 1.6 Å, active_space=(2,2), basis_set='sto-3g', transform='parity'
Creates appropriate simulator using SimulatorFactory
Creates UCCSearchController with PPO agent
Runs search with n_episodes=500 and early_stop_threshold=1.6e-3
Collects performance metrics: final energy, FCI error, circuit depth, training time, episode count
Evaluates results against chemical accuracy threshold (1.6 mHa)
Generates comprehensive validation report
Script should be executable and produce structured output

objectives.description: Implement performance metrics collection and analysis for RLQAS system validation
acceptance_criteria: Collect key metrics: final VQE energy, FCI energy error (mHa), circuit depth, number of excitation operators
Track training metrics: episode rewards, energy progression, convergence behavior
Record computational metrics: training time, simulator evaluations, memory usage
Implement metrics aggregation and statistical analysis
Save metrics in structured format (JSON, CSV) for further analysis
Generate performance summary with key indicators
Compare results against Phase 1 success criteria

objectives.description: Implement validation criteria based on chemical accuracy and system performance
acceptance_criteria: Define chemical accuracy threshold: <1.6 mHa error from FCI energy
Implement performance goals: single experiment <2 hours, reasonable resource usage
Create validation checks for each module integration
Implement error handling and validation for edge cases
Define success metrics: functional success, accuracy success, performance success, integration success
Create validation report template with all required sections
Implement automated validation checks that can be run independently

objectives.description: Generate comprehensive test report with results and analysis
acceptance_criteria: Generate formatted test report with: test configuration, results summary, performance metrics, validation outcomes
Include visualizations: energy convergence curve, reward progression, circuit architecture
Create comparison with expected results and Phase 1 goals
Document any issues, limitations, or deviations from specifications
Generate recommendations for system improvements
Save report in multiple formats: markdown, PDF (optional), HTML (optional)
Include reproducibility information: software versions, configuration, random seeds

objectives.description: Implement basic evaluation tools for RLQAS system analysis
acceptance_criteria: Create circuit analysis tools: visualize UCC circuits, count gates, measure depth
Implement energy analysis tools: track energy progression, compute errors, compare to reference
Create RL training analysis tools: plot rewards, analyze agent behavior, evaluate policy
Build configuration validation tools: verify module compatibility, check dependency versions
Implement result comparison tools: compare multiple runs, benchmark against targets
Create visualization utilities for common analysis tasks
Tools should be modular and reusable for future phases

objectives.description: Perform comprehensive integration testing of all Phase 1 modules
acceptance_criteria: Test end-to-end pipeline with LiH molecule
Verify all module imports and dependencies work correctly
Test error handling across module boundaries
Validate data flow between modules: MoleculeData → Simulator → Environment → Agent → Controller
Test configuration consistency across all modules
Verify random seed propagation for reproducibility
Run integration tests with both success and failure scenarios
Ensure system handles resource limits gracefully (memory, time)

Error handling for integration failures and edge cases

Focus on validation accuracy rather than extensive hyperparameter tuning
verification_points: System achieves chemical accuracy (<1.6 mHa error) on LiH

module_health_checks.task_001_check: Verify process_molecule('LiH', 1.6, 'UCC', active_space=(2,2)) returns valid MoleculeData with fci_energy field
module_health_checks.task_002_check: Verify SimulatorFactory.create_simulator(4) returns working QuantumSimulator instance
module_health_checks.task_004_check: Verify UCCSearchController can be instantiated with mock dependencies

chemical_accuracy_failure: 1. Verify FCI energy from Task 001 is correct (compare with known benchmark)
3. Verify RL agent is receiving meaningful rewards
4. Check if circuit architecture has sufficient expressive power
integration_failure: 1. Test each module independently with simple test cases
2. Verify data types and formats between modules
3. Check for version incompatibilities between quantum chemistry libraries
4. Verify random seed propagation across all modules
performance_exceeded: 1. Switch to fast validation configuration for debugging
2. Reduce n_episodes to 50 for initial testing
4. Monitor memory usage and adjust simulator configuration
